name: Kitty Burger
storyline: Ready for a peaceful day at Kitty Burger? Prepare warm burgers for your purring customers, complete their orders with care, and end the day surrounded by cheerful cat chatter. Kitty Burger is the cozy feline haven you’ve been looking for to escape the stress of the day.
summary: Kitty Burger is a cozy time-management simulation game where you run a burger shop together with your adorable cat assistant! Prepare delicious burgers, serve customers on time, and keep your little restaurant running smoothly. Between busy workdays, you'll meet different characters who visit your shop, each with their own stories, moods, and quirks. How you interact with them will influence the course of the game, unlocking unique story moments and multiple endings that shape the future of your little burger shop.
